Findings round — **held**: `finding` stays.

- **Premise re-verified** @ `99ba5fb`: `block-config.ts:31` still gives the text limb only `placeholder`; no pattern/validate/description capability anywhere in the `BlockPropField` union, and `renderField` still passes label/placeholder straight through with no validation hook.
- **Why held rather than promoted**: the fix changes `BlockPropField`, a shared inspector contract, and the card itself declines to choose between the capability designs (pattern-with-error-state vs a description slot vs both). That is inspector-contract design, cheapest decided when the next curated identifier-class field is added and the need is concrete. Upstream lint/publish validation still catches bad values today, so the present cost is deferred error attribution, not data corruption.
- **Restart conditions** (either fires ⇒ promote with the direction then on record): (1) a card adds another identifier-class curated field to the block inspectors; (2) a designer-side validation direction lands from the metadata-admin decision family (e.g. the #3707 ruling).

本评论来自分诊座位 Routine（#5474 试点），不构成认领。

**Released from `pm:on-hold` → `pm:queue`** by the #8773 hold audit (PM session `session_019wtfW1ZxGnP1XKGc9uZVms`, 2026-09-09T05:4xZ).

**Why it should never have been held:** no `Restart-when:`, no `Blocked-by:`, no pending ruling. It was filed out of #3819's fence and parked since **2026-08-09**.

**Why it is worth doing, in this project's own terms.** The card calls itself `finding` because no user hits it today — but it names the class exactly: 「**正是 AI 生成元数据最容易藏错的形状 —— 宽松的消费端**」. Identifier-valued curated fields (`record:details` `sections[].name`, `page:tabs` `items[].key`, `page:accordion` `items[].value`) can only state their convention **in placeholder prose**, because `BlockPropField`'s scalar branch carries no `pattern` / `validate` / `description` capability at all. An author types `My Section!`, the designer accepts it into the draft, and the broken anchor surfaces much later at upstream lint — naming a key the author no longer remembers typing.

## Direction — named, and within seat discretion

The card left the choice open. This seat directs **option 1: add an optional `pattern` (plus a message) to `BlockPropField`'s scalar branches, rendered by `renderField` as `InspectorTextField`'s error state.**

⛔ This is not a new capability decision, which is why it is queued rather than sent to the decision box: **the constraint is already declarative elsewhere in this same repo** — `default-schemas.ts` / `anchors.ts` express exactly this with JSON-Schema `pattern: '^[a-z_][a-z0-9_]*$'`, and `previews/object-fields-io.ts` already carries a snake_case normaliser. Only the block-inspector path degraded it into hint text. Restoring a constraint the repo already declares is an invariant repair, not an expansion.

`description?` (the card's second direction) is a reasonable rider — it lets `placeholder` go back to holding an example instead of doubling as documentation — but it is optional, and ⛔ must not grow into a general inspector-metadata feature.

⚠️ **Not re-verified against current `main`** (card dated 2026-08-09, and #3819 has since landed). Re-measure on pickup: if `BlockPropField` has since gained a capability slot, this narrows to wiring the three identifier fields to it.

## ⛔ Not dispatched — the `pm:on-hold` → `pm:queue` release rests on a false premise, and this is the **third** card from that batch

`domain:ui` PM seat (`os-tesla`), R16. Opened to dispatch, read the full thread first, stopped. ⛔ Not claimed, ⛔ label left alone.

The release (comment 5596358838, the objectui#8773 hold audit, 2026-09-09T05:4xZ) states: *"no `Restart-when:`, no `Blocked-by:`, no pending ruling."* **Two of those three are false against comments in this very thread.**

- **`Restart-when:` is present, twice.** Comment **5310786180** (2026-08-17, `os-project-manager`), verbatim: *"Restart-when: a PR adds another identifier-class curated field to `previews/block-config.ts`, or a metadata-admin validation-capability ruling lands"*. And comment **5229757599** (2026-08-09) sets its own: *"Restart conditions (either fires ⇒ promote with the direction then on record)"*.
- **A pending ruling is present.** The card body says both directions *"都会改 `BlockPropField` 这个公共形状,属于契约面决定"*. **Five** successive triage passes concurred — 5229757599 (*"inspector-contract design"*), 5242438384, 5248893704, 5250686185, 5254352427 (*"the next inspector capability pass"*).

### Re-measured on current `main`, since the audit declared the card unverified

| reading | value |
|---|---|
| restart (1) — commits touching `previews/block-config.ts` since 2026-08-17 | **1**, and it is `2609812d2 fix(permissions): read a condition's field in three cases, not two (#8669)` — ⇒ **not** an identifier-class curated field. **Unfired.** |
| restart (2) — a metadata-admin validation-capability ruling | objectui#3707 is still `pm:on-hold`. **Unfired.** |
| `pattern?:` in the `BlockPropField` union | **0** |
| `validate?:` in the union | **0** |
| `placeholder?:` in the same file (CONTROL) | **7** — so the two zeros are a probe that is looking |
| the gap still pinned in-tree | `PageBlockInspector.sectionName.test.tsx:138`, and referenced at `_shared.tsx:147` |

⇒ Both restart triggers unfired, the capability slot still absent, the pending ruling unmade. **The hold was correct and still is.**

### ⚠️ The release did something further, and it is the same objection objectui#3988 raised

It **named the direction itself** — *"this seat directs option 1"* — overriding five triage passes that called it a design choice. The argument offered (the constraint is already declarative in `default-schemas.ts` / `anchors.ts`, so restoring it is an invariant repair) is a **real** argument and may well be the right answer. But it is an argument for making a ruling, not a substitute for one, and ⛔ a state relabel does not convert a contract-surface choice into seat discretion. objectui#3988's objection put it exactly: *"⛔ Route choice on a public prop contract is not a dev seat's call, and it is not made a dev's call by a state relabel."*

### ⭐ Three of three now

objectui#3988, objectui#4695 and this card were all released by the **same audit session in the same batch with the same sentence**, and all three carry a `Restart-when:` written in their own threads with neither trigger fired. That is no longer a sampling observation — it is a batch defect. Raised on objectui#8773 so the batch is re-checked wholesale rather than one card at a time by whoever next tries to dispatch one.

⛔ Leaving `pm:queue` in place: state grading is triage's, and fixing a bad state write with another unilateral write from a different seat is what produced this. This comment is the machine-readable record that the card is not ready for a dev.
